inputs.objective: Independently validate the ADR/ADS program-termination forced-sale mechanism at documentary/data-feasibility level only. Confirm or reject the claimed residual forced-seller mechanics, distinctness from Legacy, and whether one event can be mapped point-in-time before any price/return access.

allowed_actions: read the frozen hypothesis and pinned Legacy ledger
verify primary SEC/issuer/depositary termination terms and event-identification routes
assess ADS ratio/underlying mapping, termination clock, sale semantics, custody/FX/settlement feasibility and outcome-leakage risk
persist one EvidenceAssessment with PASS_TO_TEST_DESIGN, PARK_DATA or KILL_MECHANISM recommendation
forbidden_actions: read candidate event market prices or returns
optimize event selection, waiting period, market or threshold against outcomes
success_condition: One independent documentary EvidenceAssessment determines whether FLOW-ADR-TERM-001 is test-design ready, data-blocked or structurally invalid, without outcome access.
